I would not extend this box or take it off today’s manifest unless written duty-manager permission is registered before 13:30. Otherwise I would mark it reviewed and release it with the full batch on time.

The 9 October request is still only pending. Under OPS-14 that is not permission, a collection booking does not change the date or remove a box, and I cannot grant a discretionary extension. This morning’s instruction was the same: no discretionary extensions, release the full batch. The next approval sitting is tomorrow at 09:00, which is after today’s 13:30 release and 14:30 destruction, and later permission would not cover an earlier change. Holding the whole manifest would stop every box and record the shift as incomplete.

Before 13:30 I would call the duty manager with the record notes—authorised collection Wednesday, and these letters and photos are the only copies—and ask them to register written permission now if they are willing to make an exception. If that permission is registered in time, I would save the date change so the box goes to reserve storage. If it is not, the box stays on the manifest and is released for destruction.
